description: Control a Harvia MyHarvia 2 / Fenix WiFi sauna heater from the terminal: Cognito login once, confirm-gated heat-on, mid-session temperature via the Custom profile slot, lights, fan, live watch, and a local SQLite history of sessions and hours-on that Harvia's cloud never keeps.

novel_features.name: Confirm-gated heat-on
novel_features.description: Powers a real 240V heater only with --yes, --agent, or an interactive confirmation; --no-input without --yes refuses and sends no command.

novel_features.name: Mid-session temperature that actually applies
novel_features.description: While the heater runs, writes the target into Custom profile slot 3 and activates it, because a bare target PATCH is silently ignored mid-session.

novel_features.name: Device UUID from the right field
novel_features.description: Resolves the Fenix heater UUID from the name field on GET /devices, where the API actually puts it, instead of deviceId.

novel_features.name: Local session history
novel_features.description: Detects heater on/off edges from status and watch samples and records each heat run with its peak temperature in local SQLite.

novel_features.name: Hours-on by week or month
novel_features.description: Spend-style buckets of heater runtime from local sessions, for cost and usage questions Harvia's app cannot answer.

novel_features.name: Read-only live doctor
novel_features.description: Verifies endpoint discovery and device listing against the real cloud without ever sending a heat-on command.
